gate_6_what_the_run_raised.metric: presence and equality with the forward run's own tally and refusal

gate_7_solve_report.claim: a solve stopped at its cap, forward or in its transpose, is warned of with its count, shows in the per-step report, and is rechecked at a tighter tolerance with the change in value and gradient reported
gate_7_solve_report.case: the periodic tube's viscosity gradient (reverse), report_rows = steps; the cap planted at one iteration on the primal solve, then on the transpose solve alone

prediction.value: primal plant: forward warning count 20 of 20 steps, every per-step row at_cap 1; transpose plant: backward warning count 20, every per-step backward row at_cap 1, the primal rows converged; with no plant both counts 0; the recheck at tolerance 1e-10 reports its change, and with the cap planted reports that its own solves stopped at the cap as well
prediction.why: a cap of one iteration cannot reach 1e-8 from a scaled start on this solve (it takes 4 to 6 iterations at 1e-8, the frozen golden reports)

gate_7_solve_report.metric: the stop counts of the report block, forward from the state, backward from the solve_report leaf's gradient

control.plant: the cap of one iteration itself (MIME_PLANT_SOLVE_CAP=primal|transpose)

gate_7_solve_report.if_wrong: a capped solve the result does not warn of: the seam does not carry the backward report
gate_7_solve_report.cannot_discriminate_if: the cap is not reached (a solve converging in one iteration): the clean run's per-step iterations are asserted above one

control.plant: (a) a value baked at build: the MRS rung's held resistance read as built whatever the radius (MIME_PLANT_GRADIENT=baked), the tube's penalty viscosity taken from the build (baked); (b) stop_gradient on the leaf (MIME_PLANT_GRADIENT=stopped)

gate_guard_flag_forms.metric: isfinite of the gradient; the flag's first step equal to the forward run's

gate_guard_flag_forms.if_wrong: a NaN gradient from a guard: the flag form does not reach the guard
